claims: The Outer Banks (OBX) in North Carolina are a 100+ mile stretch of barrier islands.
The Wright Brothers National Memorial is in Kill Devil Hills.
There are wild horses in Corolla.
There are campgrounds on Cape Lookout.
The Outer Banks has a role in early American history (Roanoke Colony).
The Outer Banks is known for "Graveyard of the Atlantic" shipwrecks.
The Outer Banks is the site of the first flight.
The Outer Banks is accessible by car from mainland NC.
Corolla, Duck, Southern Shores, Kitty Hawk, Kill Devil Hills, Nags Head, and Hatteras Island are popular towns near the Outer Banks.
The Netflix show "Outer Banks" is set in the Outer Banks.
The Netflix show "Outer Banks" is primarily filmed in South Carolina.
